d.t: JOIST ADAPTOR FOR HEIGHT-ADJUSTABLE PEDESTAL SYSTEM FOR RAISED FLOORING
d.s: SikaRoof VersiJack Joist Adaptor is an accessory used to connect an aluminium joist to the pedestal. Joist adaptors are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), and it has a twist to lock / unlock when securing the aluminium joist to the pedestal. SikaRoof VersiJack Joist Adaptor is used in conjunction with SikaRoof VersiJack and SikaRoof VersiFrame and is installed between the pedestal and the aluminium joist.
a: Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
Operates within a wide service temperature range
us: Joist adaptor for raised flooring installations on podiums, balconies, roof terraces and areas with hardscape finishes.
